title: sorghum timorense
intro: Sorghum timorense, commonly known as Timor sweet grass or sweet grass, is a type of flowering plant in the sorghum family. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum timorense, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. Additionally, Sorghum timorense has been traditionally used to aid in digestion and to soothe respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma.
